title: Truchet tiles: arcs, mazes and split triangles
purpose: Generate tileable maps of Truchet tilings: quarter-circle arcs with a consistent two-colour fill, random diagonal mazes or half-square triangles, as raised glaze, printed lines, metal inlay or cement tiles. Use for decorative floors, wall tiles, inlaid furniture, wallpaper and game backgrounds.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python truchet_tiles.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: style
parameters.meaning: 0 quarter-circle arcs, 1 diagonal maze, 2 split triangles.

parameters.name: line_width
parameters.meaning: Width of the arcs or lines as a share of a cell.

parameters.name: order
parameters.meaning: Share of cells whose turn follows the checkerboard parity instead of chance.

parameters.name: fill
parameters.meaning: Contrast of the two-colour region fill (arcs and triangles).

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: How far the lines stand above the ground (sunk below it for inlay and grout presets).

parameters.name: metal_lines
parameters.meaning: Metallic value of the lines, 1 for metal inlay.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Glazed ceramic: cobalt arcs raised over white and pale blue regions.

presets.name: maze_print
presets.description: Random diagonal maze printed in black on off-white paper.

presets.name: brass_inlay
presets.description: Brass arcs inlaid flush in dark walnut with alternating stained regions.

presets.name: triangle_floor
presets.description: Cement floor of terracotta and cream half-square triangles.

limits: Three classic tile sets on a square grid; there are no multi-scale or winged tiles, and the diagonal maze has no region fill because its regions are not two-coloured by corner parity. Line relief is a rounded profile from the exact distance, with no bevel lighting or glaze pooling. The wood and cement grounds are light noise, not full wood or stone generators. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Truchet tilings with hashed or parity orientations
Smith's quarter-circle tiles with corner-parity two-colouring
Random diagonal maze from two-way diagonal tiles
Half-square triangle tiles in four turns
Exact distance to arcs and lines with a rounded height profile
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
